ios.desc:
Monitor and manage your AdGuard Home from your iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV. Check protection, understand your network activity, and control filtering in seconds.

*Everything at a Glance*
See protection status, statistics, top clients, and top domains on a clear dashboard. Quickly control Protection, Rule Filtering, Safe Browsing, Parental Filtering, and Safe Search.

*Understand Your DNS Activity*
Explore detailed charts and inspect requests in the searchable, filterable Query Log. Review clients, domains, response details, filtering status, and DNSSEC information—or jump directly from a chart to matching requests.

*Control It Your Way*
Use Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Live Activities, Controls, and Siri Shortcuts to check and control AdGuard Home without digging through menus.

*Made for Every Apple Device*
Enjoy a native experience designed specifically for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple TV, with iCloud sync keeping your instances available across devices.

==

Features:
- Clear dashboard with server status and quick protection controls
- Control Protection, Rule Filtering, Safe Browsing, Parental Filtering, and Safe Search
- Detailed statistics with interactive charts, top clients, and top domains
- Searchable and filterable Query Log with request, response, filtering, and DNSSEC details
- Jump from Dashboard charts directly to matching Query Log requests
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Live Activities, Controls, and Siri Shortcuts
- See available AdGuard Home updates and start updates from the app
- Share your AdGuard Home statistics as a graphic
- Sync instances between iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch using iCloud
- Native support for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS
- Clean, modern interface built entirely with SwiftUI

With AdGuard Home Remote Pro:
- Add unlimited AdGuard Home instances
- Remove Statistics and Query Log limits
- Follow queries in real time with Live Log
- Create custom presets for temporarily changing protection
- Manage clients, including filtering settings, blocked services, and tags
- Manage filters, blocklists, allowlists, and custom filtering rules
- Manage DHCP and DNS settings, including static leases and DNS rewrites
- Control AdGuard Home using interactive widgets
- Configure an Away Connection for access outside your home network
- Control where instances appear with Instance Visibility
- Receive notifications and alarms
- Send URLs to AdGuard Home using the Share Extension

quotes.text:
I was going to ask if there was a way to easily turn it off from my phone, then I found this linked to from the github page:

https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1543143740?platform=iphone

This looks great. Currently I'm using Hyperweb, which is working great, but one thing I'm missing is an easy way to disable blockers for a particular site - and for it to remember that. As far as I can tell, all I can do is use Safari's 'Turn off Content Blockers' - but this doesn't seem to remember where I did it, and only seems to work temporarily / not for a whole domain, so I end up fighting with it.
quotes.story_title: AdGuard Home: Network-wide ads and trackers blocking DNS server
